propositions: Seeded-defect mutant corpus (e2_mutant_corpus.jsonl) with ≥10 mutants per class for defect classes 1–4 (class 5≥5) paired with control rows, each carrying pair_id, defect_class, role, source_ticket_id, plan_text, children, mutation_op, and mutation_diff.
Pre-registered per-class detection and blocking-FP thresholds plus INDETERMINATE run-validity cap (≥0.20) pinned in runs/e2_thresholds.json.
Pure counting helpers classify_pair and run_validity in e2_counting.py built and golden-tested offline without LLM in test_e2_counting.py.

Store-isolation mechanism implemented by construction: mutant store sourced as standalone git clone --local --branch tickets with own .git directory, preventing contamination of real .tickets-tracker.

Live ~100-run LLM batch baseline and e2_baseline.json / e2_run_validity.json / e2_verdicts.jsonl outputs permanently rejected on cost and superseded by d8a5 standing criterion_effectiveness.py recorder accumulating detection/FP signal from production reviews at zero marginal LLM cost.
